envelope.description: Record controlled shutdown evidence and verify the complete lifecycle

body.title: Record controlled shutdown evidence and verify the complete lifecycle
body.summary: Run disposable blocked-exit, healthy-control, guard-owner-killed-during-close and restart-order scenarios. Write shutdown-investigation.md with exact commands/timestamps/PID-start markers/deadlines/results/source logs, and explicitly preserve the deferred historical-cause caveat. Verify packaging, targeted lifecycle suites and typecheck; report full-suite failures accurately. Installed-daemon restart smoke is excluded until separately authorized. The installed-daemon smoke remains a separately permission-gated deployment follow-up; this build documents that it was not run rather than substituting a fabricated result. Record Linux capability integration separately from the earlier feasibility probe; do not claim Darwin support without Darwin runtime evidence.
acceptanceChecks: Required ac4 evidence document contains reproducible commands, timing, original process identity, configured bound, observed termination and healthy control with source logs.
Killing a guard owner during async close returns ownership conflict and never starts a replacement.
Documentation does not claim to establish the original October13 native cause or claim an unperformed installed-daemon smoke.
Built helper is included in compiled output and backend validation results are recorded honestly.
Acceptance reporting separates tested Linux behavior, unverified Darwin operational support, and separately authorized installed-daemon smoke.

tests.name: Controlled shutdown investigation evidence document satisfies ac4 with historical-cause caveat
Guard-owner death prevents restart while the healthy control restarts normally
Compiled helper packaging and affected lifecycle regression suites
Platform evidence matrix distinguishes Linux runtime proof from unverified Darwin support and unperformed installed smoke
